decisions.reason: The original ios P1 baseline pixel coverage shows title, subtitle, notice, all six labels/details and unavailable reasons, the no-selection summary and collapsed disclosure, Request station and the complete footer. In this two-column ordinary text layout every required word continues into readable wrapped lines without ellipsis, hidden suffixes or clipped characters. Capture-edge cuts continue in overlapping originals.

Across the complete bound ios P1 baseline content sweep, header and notice, the six choice labels/details/reasons, summary, disclosure, primary action and footer occupy separate vertical/card regions. No text, status word, card content or action occludes another item. Viewport edge fragments are covered by adjacent original frames.

Inspected all bound expanded captures [20, 21, 22, 23]; captured text is readable and no unintended collision is evident. The required whole-state wrapping proposition stays unknown; a visible footer/sentinel does not repair this coverage gap.
